questions.prompt: Which test best proves real Devnet wiring?
options: An integration test against the local node
A unit test with no I/O
questions.explanation: Local-node integration verifies deployment and RPC behavior.

questions.prompt: What should a negative test assert?
options: The precise rejection rule or error
questions.explanation: Negative tests should verify the expected failure, not merely any failure.

questions.prompt: Why record exact commands in a dev log?
questions.explanation: Commands, environment, and outputs make evidence auditable.
